title: Unani Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Amendment Ordinance 1966

sections.shortTitle: Unani Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Amendment Ordinance 1966
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE UNANI, AYURVEDIC AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1966
THE UNANI, AYURVEDIC AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1966
ORDINANCE No. II OF 1966
(Approved by the National Assembly of Pakistan on the 7th
March, 1966, see Gaz. of P., 1966, Ext., p. 94.)
[15th January, 1966]
An Ordinance to amend the Unani, Ayarvedic and Homoeopathic
Practitioners Act, 1965
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend
the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965, for the purpose
hereinafter appearing II of 1965 ;
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners (Amendment) Ordinance,
1966.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment of section 1, Act II of 1965. In the Unani, Ayurvedic
and Homoeopathic Practi tioners Act, 1965, hereinafter referred to as the said
Act, in section 1, for sub-section (3) the following shall be substituted and
shall be deemed always to have been so substi tuted, namely :--
"(3) It shall come into
force on the twenty-first day of July, 1965."

Practitioners Act, 1965
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend

hereinafter appearing II of 1965 ;
3. Validation. Anything done, action taken, order passed, rule made
or notification issued, or purporting to have been done, taken, passed, made or
issued, under the said Act, on or after the twenty-first day of July, 1965, and
before the promulgation of this Ordinance, shall be deemed to have been done,
taken, passed, made or issued under the said Act as amended by this Ordinance,
and shall have and shall be deemed always to have had effect accordingly.
